about.description: What began as a small workshop in Patan has grown into one of the most respected custom framing studios in the Kathmandu Valley — serving collectors, galleries, and homeowners alike.
about.heritageP1: FrameCraft was founded by master framer Rajan Shakya, a third-generation Newar woodworker from Patan. Trained by the master gilders of the Kathmandu Valley, Rajan brought together centuries of Newari craft tradition and contemporary design sensibilities.
about.heritageP2: Over the past 25 years, we've grown from a single workbench to a full-service studio with a team of expert artisans, designers, and conservation specialists. Every piece that leaves our workshop carries the same commitment to quality that defined our very first frame.
about.heritageP3: We believe framing is not just about preservation — it's about enhancing the way art and memories are experienced. The right frame transforms a piece, drawing the eye and elevating the space it inhabits.
about.teamBody: Each member of our team brings decades of expertise and a passion for the craft.
about.studioBody: Located in the heart of Patan's Kumaripati, our studio is both a workshop and a gallery. Step inside to see our full collection of frame samples, view completed projects on display, and consult with our designers in person.

microvisuals.leftBlurb: Forma's AI understands context, composition, and style like a creative director would.
microvisuals.rightBlurb: Describe what you see in your head — get images that actually match.
microvisuals.feature1Desc: Describe a mood, a material, an era — the model locks onto your reference and holds the thread across every generation.
microvisuals.feature2Desc: Subject, background, lighting, texture — each as a separate control. Composite without leaving the prompt.
microvisuals.feature3Desc: Adjust, remix, branch. Every generation is a starting point, not a final answer. Fork any result and take it somewhere new.
microvisuals.feature4Desc: Name a hex, drop a swatch, describe a gradient. The output respects your color system down to the highlight.
microvisuals.feature5Desc: Upscale 4× without inventing detail that wasn't there. Structure, depth, and edge integrity are preserved.
microvisuals.feature6Desc: Generate 20 variants from one prompt, each with a seeded random walk. Pick the winner, iterate on that line.
microvisuals.step1Desc: What are you making? A product shot, a concept board, a character — just say it.
microvisuals.step2Desc: Nudge the composition, swap materials, adjust the light. Real-time, no waiting.
microvisuals.step3Desc: Download at resolution. PNG, SVG, layered — your pipeline, your format.
microvisuals.ctaTitle: Ready to see what it can do?
microvisuals.ctaBody: No waitlist. No credit card. Start generating in seconds.
